I bought it in Montreal for the NAC back then.
I have several other Edges (vampire toy, etc), but I really like the frog more than the others, probably because of the crown. And the smile. And the greenness. And, obviously, because of a national love we have for frogs.

Messages.Author: ReverendRevolver
Messages.Body: My edge is a magic 8 ball. I bought it for the sole purpose of using as an edge ahwile back, and Ive gotten decent feedback at tournaments. Initially, Googly Moogly was what I was going to run at the NAC one year, so I bought the 8ball to match her. Played another deck, but the 8ball I kept. Ita big enough to remember to use.

Messages.Author: Juggernaut1981
Messages.Body:
I used to have a small stuffed Count von Count from Sesame Street (about 10cm tall), but it's gone somewhere *shrugs* GONE.

Now I use a small orange Moose toy I acquired from a particular Scandinavian flat-packed-furniture company that they sold for a very lowball price when I was looking for something else entirely. It tends to get referred to in a pun referencing the Simpsons (Moose, hired Moose... see the link for the original

)

Messages.Author: Erol
Messages.Body:
For a long time I had a black pyramid made of stone, but was lost on a EC, I think it was in Paris.

Since then I use big nicely made coins from Poker sets generated by Kickstarter projects.

But I miss my Pyramide, it had heiroglyphs on it and I found it in a hostel near Essen while I was demoing vtes on Gamefair Spiel. I opend a sideboard in my room and it was the only thing in there, somehow it was menat to be found.

- Prince of Karlsruhe, Germany
